input: I am about to adopt the recommendation set for the P1 review as a whole, ten items: adopt the rebuilt inputs pack and archive the pre-pivot business documents with supersession stubs; reframe the investment case on evidence gates with observed figures only and no month-twelve projections; amend launch criterion two so the proven billing mechanism plus an activation runbook replaces pre-launch Stripe activation, both branches presented; defer base-rate re-tuning until a real-traffic window; fix the credential fragmentation and per-install cost opacity before the first paid onboard; tell the product story per audience until the substrate migration completes; carry the lawyer engagement, Article 50 runway, and founder-personal-exposure starts as schedule constraints; refresh market sizing including the June Anthropic credit-pool change; harmonise free-tier limits across credential classes; and fix the P1 session's reading order and decision list. The set deliberately contains no revenue projections and leaves the three judgement calls — criterion two, investment-case adoption, archive timing — explicitly with the founder. My check before adopting: is the set complete against the findings, honest about what is evidence versus judgement, and free of items that decide what is the founder's to decide.
